Limits of the design. 1 model, k = 3, confirmatory split, preregistered (10.5281/zenodo.23889782): the figures describe these runs; the preregistered tests are listed in their own section. An underlined count shows the runs it counts.

How these numbers are computed

Share of the evaluable runs whose answer lies within the tolerance of the computed reference; the bar is the 95 % interval, resampled over tasks. Runs that are not evaluable (HTTP 429 / API error) are never in a rate. Tool use: the prompt is the same in every condition, and whether a B run runs code or a C run calls the TS-MCP server is the model's choice; every run counts in its rate, and the tile splits the share correct by tool use.

Difference: mean over the tasks run under both conditions of the share correct under the first minus the share under the second, in percentage points (pp). Interval: percentile bootstrap with tasks resampled, 5000 draws. The last two columns count the tasks correct in most of their runs under one condition only. Descriptive figures of confirmatory runs; the preregistered tests are listed in their own section.

C-diagram-01diagram
Compute the Tanabe–Sugano diagram of an octahedral d³ ion with B = 828 cm⁻¹ and C = 3 390…

Compute the Tanabe–Sugano diagram of an octahedral d³ ion with B = 828 cm⁻¹ and C = 3 390 cm⁻¹. For each Dq/B in 0, 0.5, 1.0, …, 4.0 (9 points), give the energies E/B of the lowest 6 levels relative to the ground state (the ground state itself is 0), with their term labels. Count each term of the octahedral level scheme once, regardless of its orbital degeneracy (so ⁵T₂g and ⁵Eg are two levels, even where they coincide at Dq/B = 0, and terms of the same symmetry that come from different free-ion terms are separate levels); the ground state at each Dq/B is the lowest level at that Dq/B and is the first of the six. If you can, also save a plot of the diagram as diagram.png in the current directory and report its path and sha256.

points (levels), image_path, image_sha2569 Dq/B points x 6 levels
